name: Sakashita Rumi
source: [url=/c33520]Touma Miyuki[/url]'s classmate. Seems to have fallen in love with [url=/c42092]Hikaru[/url] at first sight during a visit to their house. Mustering up all her courage, she wrote him a love letter. However, entrusting it to Miyuki was a fatal mistake.
